title: Dorel Asia Recalls to Repair Bunk Beds Due to Collapse and Fall Hazards
summary: The wooden side rails that run from the headboard to the footboard and hold the bunk bed's mattress in place can split and cause the bunk bed to collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 445,000 in the United States and 21,700 in Canada.

title: G.A. Gertmenian and Sons Recalls Toy Story 3 Bowling Game Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The red paint used on some bowling pins has been measured to be in excess of the maximum allowable level of 90 ppm, a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 600.

title: Kohler Recalls Engines Sold with Husqvarna, Cub Cadet, and Troy-Bilt Riding Lawn Tractors; Laceration Hazard Posed
summary: A wire connector on the engine can become disconnected causing the operator's seat switch to fail. When this happens, the blades will not shut down, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: Sheet Sanders Recalled by One World Technologies Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Pieces of the fan can break off from the fan assembly and be ejected from the product, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 300,000.

title: Girl's Hooded Sweater Recalled by El Gringo Imports Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hooded sweaters have drawstrings through the hood which can pose a strangulation or entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 300.

title: Sandbox Medical, LLC Recalls Pacifier Clip Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The clip can break apart, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 6,000.

title: Sea Elite Systems Recalls Buoyancy Control Devices Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The spring in the over pressure valve can corrode and break preventing the buoyancy control device from retaining air, posing a drowning hazard to consumers. Units: About 405 in the U.S. and 48 in Canada.

title: Tween Brands Recalls Beaded Curtains Due to Risk of Entrapment and Strangulation; Sold Exclusively at Justice Stores
summary: The beaded curtains are prone to entanglement. When an adult or child plays with or runs through the beaded curtains, the risks of entanglement and strangulation are posed. Units: About 36,000.

title: WRK Enterprises Recalls Edge and HOG Buoyancy Control Devices Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The spring in the over pressure valve can corrode and break preventing the buoyancy control device from retaining air, posing a drowning hazard to consumers. Units: About 750 in the U.S. and 20 in Canada.

title: Katie Brown Tea Light Candle Sets recalled by Meijer Inc. Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Meijer Stores
summary: The clear plastic candle holder can ignite, posing a serious burn and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,600.

title: Additional Fingertip Amputations and Lacerations Prompt Reannouncement of November 2009 Recall of Strollers by Maclaren USA
summary: The stroller's hinge mechanism poses a fingertip amputation and laceration hazard to the child when the consumer is unfolding/opening the stroller. Units: About one million (this recall was first announced in November 2009).

title: Meijer Recalls Infant Slipper Socks Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The balls at the end of the bug's antennae can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 17,400.

title: UJ Trading Recalls Knight Hawk Toy Helicopters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery housing under the helicopter canopy can overheat while charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 18,500 (previously recalled in January 2010).

title: Telstar Recalls Energy-Saving Light Bulbs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The light bulbs can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 317,000.

title: Bicycle Helmets Recalled by Bell Sports Due to Head Injury Hazard
summary: The plastic buckle that connects the chin straps can fail, causing the helmet to come off the wearer's head. This poses a head injury hazard to riders in the event of a fall. Units: About 31,100 in the United States, and about 2,500 in Canada.

title: Model Helicopters Recalled by Horizon Hobby Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The main blade grips and main rotor blades can release from the main rotor head, posing an impact and laceration hazard. Units: About 16,600 in the U.S.; 1,300 in Canada.

title: HP Expands Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled lithium-ion batteries can overheat and rupture, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 162,600 additional batteries (54,000 and 70,000 batteries were previously recalled in May 2010 and May 2009, respectively).

title: Lan Enterprises Recalls Zooper Strollers Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The opening between the armrest bar/snack tray and seat bottom of the stroller can allow an infant's body to pass through and become entrapped at the neck, posing a strangulation hazard to young children when a child is not harnessed. title: Eight Manufacturers Recall Pool and In-Ground Spa Drain Covers Due to Incorrect Ratings
summary: The recalled drain covers were incorrectly rated to handle the flow of water through the cover, which could pose a possible entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 1 million.

title: Lawson Aquatics Recalls Certain Pool Drain Covers Due to Incorrect Rating; Covers Pose Possible Entrapment Hazard to Swimmers
summary: The recalled drain covers were incorrectly rated to handle the flow of water through the cover, which could pose a possible entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 11,940 (73 units distributed).

title: Paramount Pool & Spa System Recalls Certain Drain Covers Due to Incorrect Rating; Covers Pose Possible Entrapment Hazard to Swimmers
summary: The recalled drain covers were incorrectly rated to handle the flow of water through the cover, which could pose a possible entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: 30 units distributed in the U.S. with an estimated 25 installed.

title: Waterway Plastics Recalls Certain Drain Covers Due to Incorrect Ratings
summary: The recalled drain covers were incorrectly rated to handle the flow of water through the cover, which could pose a possible entrapment hazard to swimmers and bathers. Units: About 50,850.

title: STIHL Recalls Yard Power Products Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The level of ethanol and other fuel additives can distort the toolless fuel cap, allowing fuel to spill, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 2.3 million.

title: Walmart Recalls GE Food Processors Due to Laceration and Fire Hazard
summary: The safety interlock system on the recalled food processor can fail; allowing operation without the lid secured which poses a laceration hazard. In addition, the product can emit smoke, or catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 255,000.

title: Dream on Me Recalls Drop-Side Cribs Due to Entrapment, Suffocation, Laceration, and Fall Hazards
summary: Full-Size Cribs: The drop-side rail hardware can break or fail, allowing the drop side to detach from the crib.
